snippet.title: bonitāka's aquarium of medusae | release trailer
snippet.description:
Help a marine biologist's research by piloting a submarine, as you tune in to the souls of jellyfish... and maybe help her learn a thing or two about life too! 🪼💙🪼💙

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4084590/bonitakas_aquarium_of_medusae/

my itch.io page: https://bonitaka.itch.io/

game by bonitāka 🕹️🌱
with additional help for voice acting and art from good friends 💙🪼
music by Egils Dandzbergs 🎧
sound design by Sterre Fleuren
key art on Steam by yafo 🖌️(https://www.instagram.com/yafo.zzz?igsh=a3Z1bDc0NWV1d3g5)
